title: Boundary of the cone over a boundary: ∂(0⨯∂Y) = ∂Y
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, R ∈ ℝ and Y, C ∈ D_{m+1}(ℝ^P) with spt Y ⊆ B̄_R(0) and Cone(∂Y, C), i.e. C(ω) = ∂Y(ψ) whenever ω ∈ D^{m+1}(ℝ^P), ψ ∈ D^m(ℝ^P) and ψ(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 t^m ω(tx)(x, v) dt for all x in some open N ⊇ spt ∂Y and all v. Then ∂C = ∂Y (Simon 2.31: ∂(0⨯∂Y) = ∂Y for compactly supported Y).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (Y C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)), Y.support ⊆ closedBall 0 R → (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)) (ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) m), (∃ N : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen N ∧ Y.boundary.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, ∀ v : Fin m → Eucl P, (ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ m * (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (t • x) (Fin.cons x v)) → C ω = Y.boundary ψ) → C.boundary = Y.boundary
